_notes.webDir: JSON has no comment syntax, so this field documents the choice inline. webDir is '.' (the repo root, where app.html/index.html actually live) because this project has no build step and therefore no bundled web-output directory (a 'dist/', 'build/', or 'www/' folder) for a real Capacitor project to point at. A production Capacitor setup normally expects webDir to be that bundled output, copied into the native shell by `npx cap sync` on every build; this project does not pretend one exists. If a real bundler is ever introduced, update webDir to its actual output folder.
_notes.server.url: Capacitor's native shell loads 'index.html' from webDir by default — but this repo's root index.html is the PUBLIC MARKETING GATEWAY, not the mobile reporter, so a bare local webDir load would launch the wrong page. Since there's no build step to rename/copy app.html into an index.html-named entry point, server.url instead points the native WebView directly at the deployed mobile-reporter route, so the native app launches app.html (Snap & Go / Capacitor camera+GPS bridge) rather than the dashboard. Swap this for a local webDir-based load only once a real bundler produces a dedicated native-app output folder with app.html as its own index.html.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CITIXEN UX uses your camera to document infrastructure issues anonymously. Photos are stripped of EXIF data.
